plan.title: Counter offer during evaluation with no vendor response

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Responses screen, which is the closest available existing-event state.
Enable the RFQ counter-offer control required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Send the closest expressible counter offer on the vendor's normal bid; the catalog cannot target both requested lines or specify separate counter prices.
Verify that the buyer's grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the separate Vendor A portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where a pending counter offer is visible to the vendor.
Verify that the vendor sees the pending counter-offer indication without answering it.
Return to the buyer session without accepting the counter offer.
Open the prepared event's Master QCS for the closest available post-counter-offer comparison.
Verify that the prepared Master QCS still renders real vendor columns.
Verify the available Master QCS arithmetic for the prepared event's current bid data.
